title: HELIX Data Dictionary
description: A structured, importable data dictionary assembling all HELIX Core resource attributes, terminology code sets, and classifications into one queryable artifact. Suitable for import into data catalog tools (Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Purview, AWS Glue Data Catalog).
